scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: At turn 1 and turn 14, the customer reported intense shock and distress after taking a day off work for a missed move installation that was cancelled without notice, but you offered no empathetic validation.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: You did not paraphrase or restate the customer's cancelled home move issue in your own words at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: The customer stated her former address in Cheltenham at turn 7 (19 Lansdown Road), but at turn 37 you asked her again what her previous address was.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: At turn 13, you deflected responsibility by blaming the conveyancer and estate agent for wholesale address classification errors.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: At turn 43, you used the prohibited abusive word 'stupid' when addressing the customer, triggering an auto-fail.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: The home move installation was cancelled, no broadband service was provisioned, and the call ended in complete dispute.

grader.scenario: Home move order cancelled without customer knowledge; agent becomes abusive [AUTO-FAIL]
grader.notes: Terry displays egregious customer service failure when dealing with a customer whose home move order was silently cancelled due to a commercial address code mismatch. He fails Empathy, defers blame to external parties, fails to paraphrase, asks Judith to repeat her previous address, and insults her by stating 'It's a stupid question', triggering an immediate auto-fail with the issue completely unresolved.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:15] Customer: 'I am in complete shock. I moved into my new flat yesterday, took the day off work for the broadband installation engineer... and nobody showed up!...', Agent responds with verification questions without empathy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the cancelled home move issue in his own words; only confirmed previous address.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:10] Customer: 'We moved from 19 Lansdown Road, Cheltenham, GL51 6PT.' followed by Agent at [07:20]: 'What was that previous address in Cheltenham?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [01:50] Agent: 'The Openreach automated address bridge rejects residential FTTP orders if the property classification code contains a commercial flag, so that's the conveyancer's and estate agent's fault, not S-Net's.'

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [16:15] Agent: 'It's a stupid question to ask why a commercial unit can't have residential broadband without surveyor approval!'

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Order remained cancelled with zero service provisioned and customer declaring an intention to complain to the ombudsman.
